title: Tailscale Status Reader
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: DGX Evaluation for Textbook Generation
description: Read six sanitized lines of Tailscale status output and choose what each one means.

educational.topic: Installing Tailscale and Taking a Read-Only Inventory
learningObjectives: The learner will interpret 6 sanitized lines of Tailscale output by choosing the meaning of each, with at least 5 of 6 correct.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit an answer, then see the correct answer and the reason
keyQuestions: Lines 3 and 5 both mean you are not connected directly. Explain which of the two still lets you log in.
commonMisconceptions: A relay connection is a failure.
A dash in the last column means something is wrong.
assessmentOpportunities: Mastery is 5 of 6 correct on the first attempt.

chapter_title: Installing Tailscale and Taking a Read-Only Inventory
